title: Spin-c refined two-variable series invariance for reduced plumbing trees with invertible linking matrix
source_version: Official SIGMA 19 (2023) article 011, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2023.011; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-09-30, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The proof combines reduction of Neumann-move sequences with an explicit chamber-dependent regularization of lattice theta sums. It tracks changes of linking signatures, Spin-c representatives, pseudo-branch signs and chamber choices through all three move types. The blow-up and bridge-collapse cases require different binomial coefficient convolution identities to match the refined powers of t as well as the quadratic q exponents.
author: Song Jin Ri
